meta.source: operator-configured CDN URL for Overture building vector tiles
meta.provenance: Tile artifacts are produced by pipeline/build_building_tiles.py (a real Overture Maps buildings pull, clipped to the union of 10km buffers around all AutoX branches + competitor branches) and hosted on a CDN. No values here are fabricated; this file only records WHERE the real tiles are served from. Until tiles are hosted, urls are null and the 3D scenes fall back to the curated per-city catchment buildings — nothing is invented to fill the gap.
meta.generated_by: hand-configured (paste the CDN URL after running docs/BUILDING_TILES.md)
meta.label: configuration, not measured data

catchments.note: operator CDN (Cloudflare R2) hosting the 77 per-province <slug>_catchment.json Overture pulls (real building footprints, ~35MB each — too large for git). rayong-catchment.html falls back to <baseUrl>/<slug>_catchment.json when the local file is absent; a CDN miss degrades to the calm not-pulled notice.

notes: Set buildings.pmtilesUrl to a hosted single-file .pmtiles archive (recommended — upload to Vercel Blob or Cloudflare R2; both serve HTTP range requests + CORS). The PMTiles reader is now wired in the 3D pages (platform/pmtiles-layer.js, loaded on demand), so the moment this URL is set the streamed buildings render. Alternatively set buildings.mvtUrl to a {z}/{x}/{y}.pbf tile-pyramid template for a plain static host (avoid for national scale — millions of files). The frontend prefers mvtUrl if present, else pmtilesUrl. Leave both null to keep the curated-catchment fallback. CORS must allow the Vercel site origin + the 'range' header.
